mapper.select: SELECT M.MENU_ID , M.MENU_NAME , M.MENU_NAME_ENG , M.MENU_NAME_LOC , M.MENU_DESC , M.MENU_TYPE , M.LINK_URL , M.PARENT_MENU_ID , P.MENU_NAME AS PARENT_MENU_NAME , M.MENU_LEVEL , M.SORT_NO , M.USING_YN , M.SYSTEM_TYPE FROM MENU M LEFT JOIN MENU P ON M.PARENT_MENU_ID = P.MENU_ID WHERE M.MENU_ID = #{menu_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MENU ( MENU_ID , MENU_NAME , MENU_NAME_ENG , MENU_NAME_LOC , MENU_DESC , MENU_TYPE , LINK_URL , PARENT_MENU_ID , MENU_LEVEL , SORT_NO , USING_YN , CREATE_DATE , CREATE_BY , UPDATE_DATE , UPDATE_BY , SYSTEM_TYPE ) VALUES ( #{menu_id} , #{menu_name} , NULLIF(#{menu_name_eng}, '') , NULLIF(#{menu_name_loc}, '') , NULLIF(#{menu_desc}, '') , #{menu_type} , NULLIF(#{link_url}, '') , NULLIF(#{parent_menu_id}, '') , CAST(#{menu_level} AS SMALLINT) , CAST(#{sort_no} AS INTEGER) , #{using_yn} , NOW() , #{update_by} , NOW() , #{update_by} , #{system_type} )
